_meta.purpose: Concrete Battle Frontier candidate builds for missing Pokemon, generated from Pokemon Showdown Random Battles templates and small hand-built fallbacks where only invalid roles existed.
_meta.policy: No Tera, no Tera Blast, no Z-Move roles, no Dynamax roles. RandBats movepools are normalized into deterministic four-move Frontier sets with at least one attack, usually at least two.
